notes.title: Steam Achievements Added
notes.notes:
Integrated the godotsteam plugin (a surprisingly arduous task) in order to add a few achievements.

Also reduced the file sizes of some of the documents, as this was causing occasional issues on low end machines.

notes.title: Last Update
notes.notes:
Terminal in a series of updates I've made, updates include:
- Balancing audio mix (especially in later sections)
- Added multiple save slots in conjunction with cloud backup
- Switched from Windowed to Fullscreen mode (seems like it causes less issues for non-standard monitor sizes)
- Item and Audio issues (just nice now)
I've also made minor changes to the grammar and sound design in some sections.

notes.title: Narrative adventure Sons of Saturn has you explore real-world abandoned locations
notes.notes:
Sons of Saturn seems like a pretty unique point and click adventure, with the developers using filtered photographs they took of various abandoned real-world locations for their setting.

Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2023/10/narrative-adventure-sons-of-saturn-has-you-explore-real-world-abandoned-locations
